status: Exploratory addendum specified after seeing primary behavioral probes, before ablation results
observation: Repeated-copy accuracy increased between step512 and step1000; layer3 head6 had maximum content-following attention at step1000 and later sampled checkpoints.
test: Zero the selected head's contribution immediately before its output projection. Compare unablated with head6 and two fixed same-layer controls, heads5 and7. Evaluate steps1000,8000,143000.
evaluation: Fresh 64 unique-random-token sequences, length32 repeated twice, seed20261018. Selection used primary seed20261017, evaluation uses new sequences. Use mean second-copy NLL, accuracy and first-minus-second NLL; paired sequence bootstrap 2000 resamples.
spectral_followup: At step512-to-step1000, profile Q,K,V,O head slices individually. This is descriptive, not a pre-registered detection method.
caveats: Head zeroing is an out-of-distribution causal intervention. Evidence of copying contribution is not proof of a complete induction circuit or grokking. No training.
